# Tracera

> Agent-native, multi-view requirements traceability and project management system.

## Overview

Tracera (formerly `TracerTM`, package name `tracertm`) is a high-assurance
Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) platform that links requirements to
code, tests, and deployments. It is designed for human-agent collaboration
and operates at a **critical** quality tier.

## Stack

- **Core (Rust)**: `crates/tracera-core` — MSRV 1.82, edition 2021, library crate
  (traceability engine, impact analysis, deterministic hashing).
- **Backend (Go)**: `backend/` — module `github.com/kooshapari/tracera`,
  Go 1.25, `backend/cmd/tracertm` is the main service entry point.
- **Backend (Python)**: `pyproject.toml` (hatchling) — Python 3.12 / 3.13+.
- **Frontend (TypeScript)**: `frontend/` — bun@1.1.38 + Turborepo monorepo
  with apps (`web`, `docs`, `storybook`, `desktop`, `desktop-electrobun`) and
  shared packages (`ui`, `api-client`, `types`, `state`, `config`, `env-manager`).
- **Persistence**: PostgreSQL, Redis, NATS, Neo4j.
- **Migrations**: `alembic/`.
- **Contracts**: `proto/` (Protobuf / gRPC), `openapi/`.
- **Infrastructure**: `deploy/{infrastructure,k8s,monitoring,nginx}`.
- **Observability**: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Grafana Alloy (Alloy-backed
  local stack); OTLP wire via `pheno-otel` substrate.
- **Task Runner**: `justfile` (canonical) + `Makefile` (legacy) + `mise.toml` (toolchain).

## Tier-0 meta-bundle (v22-SD1 hygiene batch, 2026-06-21)

- Meta-bundle: `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `SPEC.md`, `llms.txt`,
  `CHANGELOG.md`, `WORKLOG.md` (v2.1 schema with `device:` field per ADR-025
  / ADR-030), `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`.
- Repo config: `justfile`, `.editorconfig`, `.gitattributes`,
  `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `mise.toml`.
- CI: `.github/workflows/` (lint + test + build + audit + deny + coverage).

## Key Commands

```bash
# Rust core (MSRV 1.82)
cargo build --release
cargo test
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

# Go backend
cd backend && go build ./...
cd backend && go test ./...

# Python bindings
uv sync
uv run pytest

# Frontend (bun + turbo)
cd frontend && bun install
bun run dev        # = turbo dev --parallel
bun run build      # = turbo build

# Canonical task runner
just --list        # see all recipes
just ci            # = lint + test + build + audit + deny
just dev           # = make dev (TUI dev environment)
just coverage      # stack-detected: cargo llvm-cov / jest / pytest / go test
```

## Persistence

- **PostgreSQL** — primary data store (`backend/internal/database`).
- **Neo4j** — graph layer for requirement → code → test relations.
- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub for ingestion workers.
- **NATS** — message bus for async pipelines.

## Performance & Observability

- **Gateway**: `http://localhost:4000` (Unified URL).
- **Grafana**: `http://localhost:3000`.
- **Tracing**: shared Phenotype OTLP collector contract via the Alloy-backed
  local stack.
- **Loki** for logs, **Tempo** for traces, **Prometheus** for metrics.

## Quality Gates (CI)

- `cargo fmt --all` — Rust formatting
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — Rust lint
- `cargo test` — Rust unit + integration
- `cargo deny check` — license + advisory + ban + source
- `uv run ruff check .` — Python lint
- `uv run pytest` — Python tests
- `go test ./...` — Go tests
- `bun run lint` / `bun run typecheck` — TypeScript checks
- `cargo llvm-cov` (or `pytest --cov`, `go test -cover`, `jest --coverage`)
  — coverage gate at 80% (per ADR-040)
- `trufflehog` (pre-push) — secret scan
- `conventional-pre-commit` (commit-msg) — commit message lint

## Agent Guidelines

- All PRs require signed SLSA attestations.
- Check `VERIFICATION_POLICY.md` for quality gate rules.
- Architectural boundaries are enforced by `tach.toml` (where present).
- Use the unified gateway (port 4000) for all API and frontend interactions.
- Worklog: append 1 row per task to `WORKLOG.md` (v2.1 schema, 11 columns
  including `device:` per ADR-025 / ADR-030).
- Branch naming: `chore/<req-id>-<slug>-<date>` /
  `feat/<req-id>-<slug>-<date>`.
- Commit messages: Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.).

## Phenotype Integration

- Uses `phenotype-skills` for plugin runtime.
- Integrates with `phenotype-observability` for telemetry (OTLP wire).
- Worklog substrate: `pheno-worklog-schema` v2.1 (with `device:` field).
- Deployed via `nanovms` for edge compute.

For full details, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
